description: Log-based alert definitions for SigNoz. Statistical history stays in PostgreSQL. These alerts watch operational health, not tick noise.

alerts.name: Quant — market data gap
alerts.query: service.namespace = 'NtBot' AND body contains 'Quant data quality'

alerts.name: Quant — calculation errors
alerts.query: service.namespace = 'NtBot' AND body contains 'pipeline failed' OR body contains 'Outcome processor failed' OR body contains 'Statistical aggregation failed'

alerts.name: Quant — database errors
alerts.query: service.namespace = 'NtBot' AND body contains 'Quant persistence failed'

alerts.name: API — PostgreSQL errors
alerts.query: service.namespace = 'NtBot' AND service.name = 'ntbot-api' AND severity_text IN ['ERROR', 'Fatal'] AND body contains 'Npgsql'
